description: List one-off calendar events with their title, times, location and notes. Bound them with startDateFrom and startDateTo, or omit both for everything. An all-day event's end depends on its sourceEntityType. With no source, endDateTime is its LAST day (inclusive), or null for a single day. For 'deviceCalendar' and 'calendarSubscription' it is the day AFTER the last day (exclusive). For 'RecurringCalendarEvent' the event covers endDateTime minus startDateTime in whole days, rounded up (a single day when null). Read a 00:00Z value as its UTC date; read any other all-day value in the event's timezone when it has one.

startDateFrom.description: Range start, ISO 8601 UTC. Matches events ending, or starting if undated, at or after this.

startDateTo.description: Range end, ISO 8601 UTC. Matches events starting at or before this.

name: list_calendar_events
